resources.string: Immediately request pause for all playing or buffering media sessions when a USB disconnect event is received.\n\nEnable notification access before first use. This app monitors USB connection and accessory removal events without reading notification content. There is no added delay; even brief USB re-enumeration may pause playback. Plugging USB back in alone does not resume it; optional auto-play requires a real Deskflow connection. Already paused players are left unchanged; a failing player does not block others. This applies to all USB data connections, not just Deskflow sessions.
Status: Media control access enabled. USB disconnect events immediately request pause.
Status: Please enable notification access first.
Returns to Android home or goes back when the configured desktop middle/right-button shortcut is pressed.
Status: Android Home / Back shortcuts are enabled.
Status: Enable the accessibility service to use the desktop Home / Back shortcuts.

Configure the middle button as “Return to Android home” or the right button as “Android Back” in the desktop GUI. They send private F13 / F14 shortcuts over HID; this service consumes them and performs Home / Back. Both mappings are optional and independent. No ADB connection is required.

Reported by the desktop GUI via authorized ADB. Connected means the Deskflow handshake completed, not merely that USB is plugged in. Reports expire after 15 seconds without confirmation. Open this app once after installing; CLI sessions and connections without ADB cannot report status. Notification access is needed for media pause and optional auto-play.

Off by default. Requires an updated desktop GUI, authorized ADB and a running notification listener. Start your player once, then select it below. Each real Deskflow connection attempts play only once for a paused session that supports play; when audio forwarding is enabled, wait for the computer audio output to be ready. No player is launched, no other player is selected, and heartbeats or service restarts never retry. Manual pauses are respected. A play request does not guarantee playback.
Select player from active media sessions
No active media sessions. Open your player and play something first, then return here to select it.
Media sessions unavailable. Check notification access and that the listener is running.
Items to prepare: %1$d. Text is sent as a UTF-8 file. Then open Files & sharing in the desktop GUI, refresh and receive. No notification access is needed.
Unsupported share. Select text or up to 32 content files (1 GiB per file, 2 GiB storage total).
Ready. On your computer open Files & sharing, refresh, select these files and receive. Only an already-authorized ADB computer can read them. Unsent items can be deleted in this app.

Files received from an authorized ADB computer remain private until you save them with the system picker. They are never opened automatically. Delete saved or unsent items to free space (32 files / 2 GiB total).
Delete this private copy? This does not delete files already saved elsewhere.
Saved. You can now delete the private copy.
Transfer failed or cancelled. Check file access, free space and the 1 GiB per-file limit. Already completed files are kept; retry manually.
